description: List a PDF's AcroForm form fields — names, types, options, current values, per-field maxLength where declared — plus a paste-ready fillTemplate object for pdf_fill and a hasXFA flag (hybrid AcroForm/XFA inputs lose their XFA layer when filled). A PDF with no fillable form returns count 0. Read-only: the PDF is fetched or read but never modified. Call this FIRST when filling an unfamiliar PDF, since pdf_fill rejects unknown field names and over-length values.

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an absolute file path, an https:// URL, or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI. Use a URL or data URI when this server runs remotely (Smithery, hosted gateways) where local paths do not exist.

name: pdf_inspect

count.description: Number of form fields found; 0 when the PDF has no fillable form

fields.description: One entry per form field, in document order

maxLength.description: Longer values are rejected by pdf_fill

type.description: text, checkbox, dropdown, radio, optionlist, or unsupported

fillTemplate.description: Field name to empty-or-current value, ready to edit and pass to pdf_fill

hasXFA.description: True for hybrid AcroForm/XFA documents, whose XFA layer is dropped when filled

truncated.description: True when the form exceeded an API enumeration cap; fields is then a prefix, not the full list

title: Inspect PDF form fields
